title: Local Resume Tailoring Assistant
facts: Built a Dockerized workflow that converts profile facts and job descriptions into structured resume drafts.
Added JSON validation and deterministic rendering so generated content stays reviewable before export.
Designed the app as a local-first system where private profile data remains outside the public repository.

title: Project Analytics Dashboard
facts: Created a dashboard for filtering project data, comparing status, and surfacing bottlenecks.
Modeled reusable UI state for search, sorting, and saved filters.
Documented setup steps so another developer could run the project locally.

title: Automation Toolkit
facts: Wrote command-line utilities for parsing files, validating inputs, and producing reproducible reports.
Used clear configuration files to separate personal data from reusable code.
Improved repeatability by replacing manual checklist steps with scripted checks.
